SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 24002495
DOCKET NO. F2480018
PLAINTIFF – JPMORGAN CHASE BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION
DEFENDANTS- JOYCE M. JEFFERSON; FORD MOTOR CREDIT COMPANY LLC , A DE LLC; IN & OUT BAIL BONDS INC N/K/A IN AND OUT BAIL BONDS LLC; WELLS FARGO BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION; HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORP; CAPITAL ONE BANK; STATE FARM INDEMNITY COMPANY, ON BEHALF OF PATRICK WOLLACK; HOUSEHOLD FINANCE CORPORATION III; UNITED STATES OF AMERICA; STATE OF NEW JERSEY
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 20th DAY OF May 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of PLAINFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 30 BLOCK 438
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
48-50 ANDOVER AVENUE PLAINFIELD, NJ 07062
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Nearest Cross Street: MILTON PLACE
Being known and as lots#32 and 33, block “B” as shown on a certain map entitled “ merchants Park situated in the City of Plainfield, Union County, and North Plainfield Township, Somerset County, New Jersey, July 1923” as filed in the office of the Register of Union County, New Jersey on April 1, 1924, as map# 164D
"THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION."
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUMBRANCES
TRASH OPEN AND DUE $175.64
TRASH OPEN PLUS PENALTY $460.24
SEWER OPEN AND DUE $61.50
SEWER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $182.99
BANKRUPTCY SEWER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $459.00
BANKRUPTCY TRASH OPEN PLUS PENALTY $1,032.45
TOTAL AS OF April 10, 2026: $2,371.82
Good faith estimate of upset price: $527,119.34
The occupancy status of the property being foreclosed herein is presently unknown.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $357,443.96 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: April 10, 2026
FEIN, SUCH, KAHN, SHEPARD, P.C.

PARSIPPANY, NJ 07054
973-538-4700
